## Logs

<!--
You MUST include debug logs in your bug report. To capture these see:
https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/configuration/troubleshooting/#debug-logs-and-diagnostics

Once debug logging is enabled, reload the integration to ensure logs are captured from the start.

In the collected logs, look for: "Setting up Bestway integration"

Following this, the integration prints out discovered devices and supported features, e.g.
INFO (MainThread) [custom_components.bestway.coordinator] Device ...
DEBUG (MainThread) [custom_components.bestway.coordinator] Features for ...

You MUST include these device description lines in your bug report.

From this point on, look for logs from "custom_components.bestway" and copy in log entries relevant to your bug report.
If any physical buttons are pressed on the device, or controls adjusted via the official app, please annotate the log to indicate exactly what happened and when.
-->
